meta.name: loop-dev-plan
meta.description: Iterate development from plans in .cursor/plans. Implements plan tasks, validates self-testing, marks complete, moves to docs/plans/done/, and commits. Use when user wants to work through pending plans with validate-review-commit loop.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 按开发计划逐项实现任务,自动校验并提交
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果习惯先写计划再按步骤实现并持续提交代码
copy.tagline_en: Implement plan tasks step by step, validate and commit automatically
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you work through written plans with incremental commits

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会按 `.cursor/plans/` 文件夹里的开发计划逐项工作:读计划、写代码、跑测试、审查代码、提交本地版本,再把计划移入 `docs/plans/done/`,然后处理下一个计划,直到没有待办计划。
howto.when: 当你想按 `.cursor/plans/` 中的待办计划推进开发,并要 Claude 走完‘实现—自测—审查—提交’的循环时触发;也可以直接说‘处理下一个计划’等。

say.text: 请按 .cursor/plans 里的计划继续开发
say.note: Claude 会从最早的待办计划开始,完成后循环下一个。

say.text: 处理下一个待办计划,并完成自测和代码审查
say.note: Claude 会实现、验证、提交,并归档该计划。

say.text: 把 .cursor/plans 里所有计划都做完并提交
say.note: 会循环处理直到全部完成并归档。

howto.what_en: Claude will loop through development plans in .cursor/plans: implement tasks, run self-tests, review code, commit locally, then move the plan to docs/plans/done/ and continue until no pending plans remain.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user wants to work through pending plans in .cursor/plans with the validate-review-commit loop, e.g., asking to continue development or process the next plan.

say_en.text: Continue development using the plans in .cursor/plans.
say_en.note: Claude will start with the oldest pending plan and loop until done.

say_en.text: Process the next pending plan, with self-testing and code review.
say_en.note: It will implement, validate, commit, and archive that plan.

say_en.text: Complete and commit all plans in .cursor/plans.
say_en.note: It will loop through each until none remain.
